verdict.rationale: jo is a personal AI agent, so plugging in MCP servers as a client is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence documents only built-in integrations (GitHub, Linear, Slack-style catchup, decks) and an OpenAPI spec of its own backend. Nothing in the pack mentions connecting user-supplied MCP servers, and first-party integrations are an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
